facts.text: I teach at Thornton Township High School in Harvey, Illinois.
Thornton Township High School has about 67.5% Black students.
Thornton Township High School has about 29% Latino students.
Thornton Township High School has about 2.5% Asian students.
The Asian students at Thornton Township High School are identified as Indians of the Muslim faith.
Thornton Township High School has less than 1% White students.
At Thornton Township High School, 17.3% of students are classified as English Language Learners.
At Thornton Township High School, teacher representation is 53.8% White.
At Thornton Township High School, teacher representation is 36.3% Black.
At Thornton Township High School, teacher representation is 6.8% Latino.
At Thornton Township High School, teacher representation is 1.8% Asian.
The teacher demographics are district wide for Thornton, Thornridge, and Thornwood.
I believe the level of cultural responsiveness at my school is relatively low.
I send letters and report cards home in English and Spanish.
Announcements on the intercom at my school are always only in English.
I estimate that announcements only in English leave about 17% of students out.
In my Yearbook class, I have 3 students out of about 25 who speak almost only Spanish.
I give directions in English and Spanish so students can understand the tasks.
I type up what I plan to say in Google Translate to provide Spanish directions.
My current level of Spanish is around the upper beginner level.
I am working to increase my Spanish due to the changing demographics of my school.
I want to reach all my students and families.
I believe the school as a whole should increase efforts to reach Spanish-speaking students to make them feel more welcome.
